title: unified-rollouts: add canary, A/B, shadow traffic and automated rollback workflows
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: provide a single, unified rollout framework that supports canary deploys, A/B tests, shadow traffic, and automated rollback policies so product teams can safely ship model changes across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments without bespoke scripts. Summary: this PR adds a Rollout API (rollouts.proto + server-side controller), an execution engine for gradual traffic shifts, a policy system for automated rollback on metric regressions, console UIs for creating and monitoring rollouts, and end-to-end tests. Key features: 1) Canary and A/B primitives: percentage-based traffic split, weighted variants, start/end time windows, and max-ramp steps; 2) Shadow traffic: configurable copy of live traffic to a target variant for silent validation; 3) Automated rollback: health-check and metric-driven rollback rules (latency, error-rate, quality delta via eval hooks) with optional grace windows and escalation steps; 4) Safe fallbacks: automatic fallback to pinned stable model if rollout fails or controller loses quorum; 5) Observability: rollout-level metrics, traces, per-variant cost-estimates, and alert hooks integrated with the Console; 6) API/SDK: new Rollout API endpoints, small additions to TS/Python SDKs for create/get/list operations; 7) Migration path: default rollout controller is off by default in existing clusters; operators can opt-in via feature flag and run a one-time migration to create rollout CRDs. Backwards compatibility: rollout API is additive and does not change existing inference request paths; routing chooses rollout-aware matcher only if rollout config is present. Testing: unit tests for controller logic, integration tests simulating gradual ramp and automated rollback, e2e in perf-canary harness with synthetic traffic patterns. Checklist: implemented proto + server controller, added console rollout panel, SDK bindings, integration and e2e tests, added docs/README, feature flag gating, manual rollout plan in PR description. Related: ENG-924 (rollout engine), ENG-931 (console UI), ENG-958 (rollback policies).

review_comments: Ethan Chen: Please add unit tests covering the edge case where two variants have identical weights and a scheduled ramp triggers. Author reply: Added a targeted unit test and a comment explaining deterministic tie-breaker in commit 3.

Priya Singh: The rollback threshold defaults look aggressive for high-p99 workloads. Suggest making defaults conservative and document how to tune per-model. Author reply: Lowered default thresholds and added tuning docs in README.md commit 7.

Luca Moretti: How does this interact with existing KV cache routing? Could we accidentally violate cache locality when splitting traffic? Author reply: Executor respects cache affinity tags; added cache-affinity hints to rollout proto and added integration test covering cache hot paths.
Isabella Park: CI integration tests flaked on first run due to timing in perf-canary harness. Author reply: Increased harness timeouts and added deterministic seed; reran integration pipeline.
release_notes: Add unified rollout framework: canary deploys, A/B experiments, shadow traffic, and automated rollback workflows. Console UI for creating and monitoring rollouts. SDK methods for rollout lifecycle. Rollout controller is feature-gated; operators must opt-in and run migration. Default rollback thresholds are conservative and tunable.
